text:
maria: Heads-up — launching CrossPlay marketplace SKU with hardware partner this Thurs. Need a short handoff: partner SEV path, shared slack channel, and war-room owner for the first 72h.
kevin: +1. Do we want a dedicated #crossplay-oncall or reuse marketplace-hotline?
maria: Prefer dedicated channel for visibility. marketplace-hotline is noisy and has different routing.
raj: I can be primary for first 24h then hand to elena. Will set up rotation in PagerDuty.
elena: OK for me. Can we make the channel private but invite partner SIs and a read-only observer role for marketplace support?
kevin: Yes — private makes sense for initial launch. Partner wants two SI reps and one HW firmware lead.
sarah: Quick checklist: 1) create channel 2) add partner + SI + ops-bot 3) pin escalation doc 4) create war-room bridge link 5) set PD escalation to level-1 oncall
maria: I'll draft the escalation doc. Key points: severity definitions, contact tree, allowed fallbacks (model variant -> fallback region), and who can declare SEV.
kevin: Suggest small runbook snippet pinned with commands to collect logs and model config:
```
# collect inference traces
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trace?session=$SESSION > traces.json
# dump runner status
redwoodctl runner status --id $RUNNER > runner.txt
```
raj: Nice. Also add how to escalate to Dedicated capacity team and the oncall for marketplace infra (pager id PD-1234).
elena: For partner comms, let's have a single thread template: subject, short summary, what we saw, steps taken, next actions, owner. Keeps SI aligned.
ops-bot: Reminder: create private channel command: `/channel create private #crossplay-launch --members maria,kevin,elena,raj,sarah,partner-ops` (bot will DM confirmation)
maria: I'll create the channel now and invite partner-ops + SI reps. Also creating a google doc for the escalation ladder and posting link in pinned items.
kevin: I'll set up the war-room bridge (zoom + recording) and post link in the channel once created.
sarah: Quick test before Thurs: simulate a degraded-latency SEV and run through the checklist with a 15min drill. Can we schedule Monday 11am for dry-run?
maria: Monday 11am works. Raj, can you run the drill lead?
raj: yep — I'll own the drill and post the after-action notes.
elena: One more ask: add a 'fallback routing' note — if the marketplace region hits capacity, fallback to `eu-west-1-fallback` with model-variant `quant-v2` and notify partner ops.
maria: agreed. I'll include that in the pinned doc.
kevin: Thanks all. I'll also update the Partner Ops playbook with the new channel name and PD mapping.
maria: Thanks — closing this thread once channel & doc are live. :thumbsup:
